missionText:
We save those who cannot call for help.
We create a space of safety and care for animals in Kyiv.
Our team goes where an animal is trapped: in trees, basements, rooftops, or damaged ecosystems. Places that can't be reached without special equipment and skills.
We help both pets and wild animals — anyone who’s in trouble.
We’re there when an animal is on the verge of giving up.
Domestic or wild — it doesn’t matter to us. Only one thing matters: can we give them a chance.
And we do everything to give every creature a chance for rescue and a new life.
helpSubtitle: Before reaching out to us, please review our list of services and our contact guidelines.
